title: The Spotlight: A General Method for Discovering Systematic Errors in Deep Learning Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the 'spotlight' method (searching for contiguous high-loss regions in the model's final hidden layer representation space) to a gender prediction model trained on the FairFace dataset, which automatically surfaced a cluster of systematic errors on images of young children.

Using the 'spotlight' method on the FairFace dataset to identify contiguous high-loss regions in the model's representation space, revealing systematic performance drops on specific racial groups, specifically Asian faces and faces with dark skin tones.

Evaluating a DistilBERT sentiment analysis model on the Amazon polarity dataset using the 'spotlight' method, discovering a systematic error where the English-trained model consistently misclassified reviews written in Spanish as negative.
